thread:
alex: Morning, sprint-sundown sync — quick heads-up: landed kernel prefetch patch on canary and saw avg token latency -8% on 2k seq tests. Microburst p95 still ~380ms on some nodes though, likely due to slot contention. Blocker: need to re-evaluate slot-steal heuristics, can't reproduce locally.

maria: Nice. Can you paste the perf run link? Also I saw 5% higher CPU on that canary. Could be scheduling.

alex: https://perf.internal/runs/599876 - look at 'long-seq-2048' trace. CPU bump correlates with tensor-copy fallback on older cu kernel.

jin: Heads-up, CR #438 (kernel prefetch) has one minor comment about cache invalidation in async path. I pushed a fix. @alex can you quick review?

alex: Will review in 30m.

sam: Small bench report: raw tokens/sec for batcher1 improved from 560 -> 610 on A100 when prefetch enabled. Attached snippet:
```
batch_size, before, after
8, 560, 610
16, 870, 970
```

nina: Picking up KV eviction tuning today. Found a pattern where tiny requests cause frequent evict thrash. Plan: raise hotness threshold and add 10s decay.

alex: Sounds good. If anyone can triage a reproducible microburst I'll pair. My hunch: it aligns with shard handoff events.

maria: Re: CR review, left an inline on a log noise -> can we drop verbose in prod? :ear:

jin: deploy-bot: canary deploy for prefetch patch succeeded on 3/4 hosts, one host OOM'd briefly but auto-recovered. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 5998765460. No regressions in smoke tests. Rolling to remaining hosts in 15m.

sam: Blocker for me: CI bench flakiness—rerunning with isolated quota. Will update thread.

nina: Today I'll open a short RFC for eviction policy adjustments and a small perf test harness for microburst reproducer.

alex: Cool. TL;DR: landed prefetch canary, need review on CR fix, nina + sam working on eviction and CI flakiness. Ping me @here if you hit a hot microburst trace.
